title: BetterBoss
description: Strengthen weak bosses to make them easier to fight.
body:
# BetterBoss

A Paper plugin that overhauls vanilla boss fights with harder mechanics, extra phases, and custom rewards.

The first module focuses on the **Ender Dragon** in the End.

## Features (Better Ender Dragon)

- **Enhanced End Crystal** — craftable upgrade used to start an enhanced dragon fight (place four near the exit portal during the respawn ritual).
- **Two-phase fight** — higher max health, stronger attacks in later phases, and a mid-fight phase transition with invulnerability and custom boss bar behavior.
- **End-game mechanics** — crystal beam attacks, crying obsidian pillar regeneration, fake endermite distractions, and reduced effectiveness of arrows/explosions after the dragon drops below half health.
- **Rewards** — bonus experience on kill and a loot chest spawned on the central bedrock pillar.

Progress and fight state persist per End world so enhanced runs survive restarts.

## Requirements

- **Paper** (or compatible fork) for Minecraft **1.21.x**
- **Java 21**

## Compatibility

This plugin has **only been tested on Minecraft 1.21.11**.

Other 1.21.x versions may work but are not verified.

## Roadmap

- **Wither** and other bosses are planned for future modules under the same BetterBoss umbrella.
- More bosses and tuning options may land in later releases.
